statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail), and r, interpreted as a mathematical integer, is exactly the number of index triples (i,j,k) such that 0 <= i < j < k < len(nums), nums[j] - nums[i] = diff, and nums[k] - nums[j] = diff. Distinct index triples are counted separately, so each such (i,j,k) contributes 1 to r.
preconditions: len(nums) is an integer with 3 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 200; 1 <= diff <= 50; and for every i, j with 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] < nums[j].

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, interpreting r as a mathematical integer, r <= len(nums) - 2.
preconditions: len(nums) is an integer with 3 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 200; 1 <= diff <= 50; and nums is strictly increasing.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is equal to the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) for which both values nums[i] + diff and nums[i] + 2*diff occur as elements of nums. Equivalently, for such an i there exist p, q with 0 <= i < p < q < len(nums), nums[p] = nums[i] + diff, and nums[q] = nums[i] + 2*diff.
preconditions: len(nums) is an integer with 3 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 200; 1 <= diff <= 50; and nums is strictly increasing.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, if nums[len(nums)-1] - nums[0] < 2*diff, then r = 0.
preconditions: len(nums) is an integer with 3 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 200; 1 <= diff <= 50; and nums is strictly increasing.

statement: The function returns a result r on (nums, diff) and a result r2 on (nums2, diff), and r = r2.
preconditions: nums and diff satisfy the constraints of spec_1: 3 <= len(nums) <= 200, every nums[i] satisfies 0 <= nums[i] <= 200, 1 <= diff <= 50, and nums is strictly increasing. Let c be an integer and let nums2 be a slice of the same length such that nums2[i] = nums[i] + c for every i and 0 <= nums2[i] <= 200 for every i.

statement: The function returns a result r on (nums, diff) and a result r2 on (nums2, diff2), and r = r2.
preconditions: nums and diff satisfy the constraints of spec_1: 3 <= len(nums) <= 200, every nums[i] satisfies 0 <= nums[i] <= 200, 1 <= diff <= 50, and nums is strictly increasing. Let k be a positive integer, let nums2[i] = k * nums[i] for every i, and let diff2 = k * diff. Assume nums2 satisfies 0 <= nums2[i] <= 200 for every i and that 1 <= diff2 <= 50.

statement: The function returns a result r on (nums, diff) and a result r2 on (nums2, diff), and r <= r2.
preconditions: nums and nums2 are slices satisfying the constraints of spec_1 with the same diff: 3 <= len <= 200 for each, all elements are between 0 and 200, 1 <= diff <= 50, and each slice is strictly increasing. In addition, nums is a subsequence of nums2: there are indices f(0) < f(1) < ... < f(len(nums)-1) < len(nums2) with nums2[f(i)] = nums[i] for every 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for each j with 1 <= j < len(nums)-1 let b(j) = 1 if there exists i with 0 <= i < j and nums[j] - nums[i] = diff and there exists k with j < k < len(nums) and nums[k] - nums[j] = diff, and let b(j) = 0 otherwise. Then r = b(1) + b(2) + ... + b(len(nums)-2).
preconditions: len(nums) is an integer with 3 <= len(nums) <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= nums[i] <= 200; 1 <= diff <= 50; and nums is strictly increasing.
